    function createAutoMovePlugin(duration = AUTO_MOVE_SPEED_MS) {
        return (slider) => {
            let timeout = null;
            let isUserInteracting = false;
            let isDragging = false;

            const animation = {
                duration: duration,
                easing: (t) => t
            };

            function next() {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                if (isUserInteracting || isDragging) return;
                slider.moveToIdx(slider.track.details.abs + 1, true, animation);
            }

            function stop() {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                if (slider.animator) {
                    slider.animator.stop();
                }
            }

            function scheduleRestart(delay = 500) {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                timeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (!isUserInteracting && !isDragging) {
                        next();
                    }
                }, delay);
            }

            slider.on('dragStarted', () => {
                isDragging = true;
                stop();
            });

            slider.on('dragEnded', () => {
                isDragging = false;
                scheduleRestart(800);
            });

            slider.on('created', () => {
                slider.container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    isUserInteracting = true;
                    stop();
                });

                slider.container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    isUserInteracting = false;
                    scheduleRestart(300);
                });

                let dragMoved = false;
                slider.on('dragChecked', () => {
                    dragMoved = true;
                });

                slider.container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (dragMoved) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        dragMoved = false;
                    }
                }, true);

                next();
            });

            slider.on('animationEnded', () => {
                if (!isUserInteracting && !isDragging) next();
            });

            slider.on('updated', () => {
                if (!isUserInteracting && !isDragging) next();
            });
        };
    }

    // ==========================================
    // API
    // ==========================================
    async function fetchDafitiProduct(sku) {
        if (productCache.has(sku)) return productCache.get(sku);

        try {
            const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}?key=product_${sku}`);
            if (!res.ok) {
                productCache.set(sku, null);
                return null;
            }
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
                productCache.set(sku, null);
                return null;
            }

            const meta = data.meta || {};
            const images = (data.images || [])
                .map(img => img.url)
                .filter(Boolean)
                .map(url => `${IMAGE_CDN_BASE}${url}-product.jpg`);

            const simples = data.simples || {};
            const hasStock = Object.keys(simples).some(key => Number(simples[key]?.meta?.quantity || 0) > 0);

            if (!meta.name || images.length === 0 || !hasStock) {
                productCache.set(sku, null);
                return null;
            }

            const price = Number(meta.price);
            const specialPrice = meta.special_price ? Number(meta.special_price) : null;

            const parsed = {
                sku,
                name: meta.name,
                price: Number.isFinite(price) ? price : 0,
                specialPrice: specialPrice && Number.isFinite(specialPrice) ? specialPrice : null,
                images,
                url: data.link ? `${SITE_BASE}${data.link}` : '#'
            };

            productCache.set(sku, parsed);
            return parsed;
        } catch (e) {
            productCache.set(sku, null);
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // DOM BUILDERS
    // ==========================================
    function createSkeletonSlide() {
        const slide = document.createElement('div');
        slide.className = 'keen-slider__slide card-skeleton';
        slide.innerHTML = `
            <div class="img-skeleton"></div>
            <div class="skeleton-line" style="width: 100%;"></div>
            <div class="skeleton-line" style="width: 65%;"></div>
            <div class="skeleton-line" style="width: 40%; height: 1rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;"></div>
        `;
        return slide;
    }

    function createProductSlide(product, category) {
        const slide = document.createElement('div');
        slide.className = 'keen-slider__slide';

        const finalPrice = product.specialPrice !== null ? product.specialPrice : product.price;
        const hasDiscount = product.specialPrice !== null && product.specialPrice < product.price;

        const priceHtml = hasDiscount
            ? `<del class="del">${currencyFormatter.format(product.price)}</del><span class="por">${currencyFormatter.format(finalPrice)}</span>`
            : `<span class="por">${currencyFormatter.format(finalPrice)}</span>`;

        slide.innerHTML = `
            <a class="card btn_ga_click" href="${product.url}" onclick="sendClickEventGA(this)" draggable="false">
                <img 
                    class="img_ga_view" 
                    src="${product.images[0]}" 
                    alt="${product.name.replace(/"/g, '"')}" 
                    data-creative="favorites-${category.toLowerCase()}-${product.sku}" 
                    data-name="${product.sku}" 
                    loading="lazy" 
                    draggable="false"
                />
                <p class="textProd">${product.name}</p>
                <div class="product-card__price">
                    ${priceHtml}
                </div>
            </a>
        `;
        return slide;
    }

    // ==========================================
    // INICIALIZAÇÃO DO KEEN SLIDER
    // ==========================================
    function mountKeenSlider(category, withAutoMove = true) {
        const container = document.querySelector(`#slider-${category}`);
        if (!container || !SliderConstructor) return;

        if (keenInstances[category]) {
            try { keenInstances[category].destroy(); } catch (err) {}
            delete keenInstances[category];
        }

        const totalSlides = container.querySelectorAll('.keen-slider__slide').length;
        if (totalSlides === 0) return;

        const plugins = (withAutoMove && totalSlides > 5) ? [createAutoMovePlugin(AUTO_MOVE_SPEED_MS)] : [];

        keenInstances[category] = new SliderConstructor(container, {
            loop: totalSlides > 5,
            renderMode: 'performance',
            drag: true,
            dragSpeed: 1.2,
            slides: {
                perView: 5,
                spacing: 5
            },
            breakpoints: {
                '(max-width: 1024px)': {
                    slides: { perView: 3.5, spacing: 5 }
                },
                '(max-width: 768px)': {
                    slides: { perView: 2.2, spacing: 5 }
                },
                '(max-width: 480px)': {
                    slides: { perView: 1.5, spacing: 5 }
                }
            }
        }, plugins);
    }

    function renderSkeletons(category) {
        const container = document.querySelector(`#slider-${category}`);
        // 8 cards para preencher a tela e garantir totalSlides > 5 para rodar
        const skus = (SKUS_BY_CATEGORY[category] || []).slice(0, 8);
        if (!container) return;

        container.innerHTML = '';
        const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
        skus.forEach(() => fragment.appendChild(createSkeletonSlide()));
        container.appendChild(fragment);

        mountKeenSlider(category, true);
    }

    async function loadCategory(category) {
        if (loadedCategories.has(category)) return;
        loadedCategories.add(category);

        const container = document.querySelector(`#slider-${category}`);
        const skus = (SKUS_BY_CATEGORY[category] || []).slice(0, MAX_PRODUCTS_PER_CATEGORY);
        if (!container || skus.length === 0) return;

        const validProducts = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < skus.length; i += CONCURRENCY_LIMIT) {
            const batch = skus.slice(i, i + CONCURRENCY_LIMIT);
            const results = await Promise.all(batch.map(sku => fetchDafitiProduct(sku)));
            
            results.forEach(prod => {
                if (prod) validProducts.push(prod);
            });

            if (i + CONCURRENCY_LIMIT < skus.length) {
                await wait(DELAY_BETWEEN_BATCHES_MS);
            }
        }

        if (validProducts.length === 0) return;

        container.innerHTML = '';
        const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
        validProducts.forEach(prod => fragment.appendChild(createProductSlide(prod, category)));
        container.appendChild(fragment);

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            mountKeenSlider(category, true);
        });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // ABAS E NAVEGAÇÃO
    // ==========================================
    function setupTabs() {
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.favorites .tab');
        const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.favorites .carousel-wrap');

        function switchTab(category) {
            tabs.forEach(t => {
                const isActive = t.getAttribute('data-category') === category;
                t.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
                t.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
            });

            panels.forEach(panel => {
                const isCurrent = panel.getAttribute('data-panel') === category;
                panel.hidden = !isCurrent;
            });

            if (!loadedCategories.has(category)) {
                renderSkeletons(category);
                loadCategory(category);
            } else {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    mountKeenSlider(category, true);
                });
            }
        }

        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                switchTab(tab.getAttribute('data-category'));
            });
        });

        // Setas manuais
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-slider-prev]').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const sliderId = btn.getAttribute('data-slider-prev');
                const cat = sliderId.replace('slider-', '');
                if (keenInstances[cat]) keenInstances[cat].prev();
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-slider-next]').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const sliderId = btn.getAttribute('data-slider-next');
                const cat = sliderId.replace('slider-', '');
                if (keenInstances[cat]) keenInstances[cat].next();
            });
        });

        // Detecta a categoria pela URL e inicia nela
        const initialCategory = getCategoryFromUrl();
        switchTab(initialCategory);
    }

    function init() {
        const favorites = document.querySelector('.favorites');
        if (!favorites || favorites.dataset.ready) return;
        favorites.dataset.ready = 'true';

        setupTabs();
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();
</script>

  var TRIGGER_CLASS = 'search-toggle-icon';
  var OPEN_CLASS = 'dfx-search-open';

  function init() {
    var searchContainer = document.querySelector(
      '.input-search-container.input-search-container__msite'
    );
    var headerRight = document.querySelector('.l-header-right');
    if (!searchContainer || !headerRight) return;
    if (document.querySelector('.' + TRIGGER_CLASS)) return;

    var trigger = document.createElement('button');
    trigger.type = 'button';
    trigger.className = TRIGGER_CLASS;
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Abrir busca');
    trigger.innerHTML = '<i class="icon-magnifier" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
    headerRight.insertBefore(trigger, headerRight.firstChild);

    var input = searchContainer.querySelector('.open-search-input');

    function open() {
      searchContainer.classList.add(OPEN_CLASS);
      if (input) input.focus();
    }

    function close() {
      searchContainer.classList.remove(OPEN_CLASS);
    }

    trigger.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (searchContainer.classList.contains(OPEN_CLASS)) {
        close();
      } else {
        open();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (
        searchContainer.classList.contains(OPEN_CLASS) &&
        !searchContainer.contains(event.target) &&
        event.target !== trigger
      ) {
        close();
      }
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>

        if (!sku) return;
        _paTrack({ event_name: 'add_to_cart', properties: { sku: sku } });
    }, true);

        if (!link) return;
        var item = link.closest('[data-sku]');
        var sku = item ? item.getAttribute('data-sku') : '';

        document.getElementById("recent-search-container").classList.remove(oldClass);
        document.getElementById("recent-search-container").classList.add(newClass);
    }

    const onFocus = () => {
        const MAX_TO_VISIBLE = 1;
        const elementInputValue = document.getElementById("input-search").value;
        if (elementInputValue.length <= MAX_TO_VISIBLE) {
            replaceStyleClass('hiddenRecentSearchList', 'showRecentSearchList');
        }
        document.getElementById("backdrop").style.visibility = 'visible';
    }

    const onFocusOut = (event) => {
        const buttonDelete = document.getElementById('removeCookie');
        if (!buttonDelete || !buttonDelete.contains(event.target)) {
            replaceStyleClass('showRecentSearchList', 'hiddenRecentSearchList');
            document.getElementById("backdrop").style.visibility = 'hidden';
        }
    }

    document.getElementById("input-search").addEventListener('focusin', onFocus);
    document.getElementById("backdrop").addEventListener('click', onFocusOut);

    function deleteCookie(searchTerm) {
